basic_details.short_information: Tata Memorial Centre (TMC) has released the official Scientific Assistant Notification 2026 on its official website, https://tmc.gov.in. A total of 1 vacancy has been announced under the TMC Scientific Assistant Recruitment 2026. Candidates holding an M.Sc. in Clinical Research or Public Health along with a computer course in office software are eligible to attend the walk-in interview on 11 August 2026. The official notification PDF and walk-in interview details are available below.

content_sections.heading: TMC Scientific Assistant Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the TMC Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download TMC Scientific Assistant Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: TMC Scientific Assistant Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 1 vacancy is available – 1 for the Scientific Assistant post.

content_sections.heading: TMC Scientific Assistant Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Scientific Assistant: M. Sc. in clinical research/ Public Health with a computer course in office software. Preference for candidates with one year of experience in data analysis/ Cancer registry operation/ Clinical research.

content_sections.heading: TMC Scientific Assistant Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for the TMC recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for the Tata Memorial Centre recruitment is Scientific Assistant. This is a project-based role within the research field.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies announced?
faq.answer: Tata Memorial Centre has announced a total of 1 vacancy for the Scientific Assistant position through this walk-in drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the required educational qualification for the Scientific Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M. Sc. degree in clinical research or Public Health, along with a computer course in office software. Experience in data analysis or cancer registry is preferred.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Scientific Assistant position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Scientific Assistant post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 45,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application for this recruitment is a Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to attend the interview directly with their documents.

faq.question: Q6. When and where is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 11th August 2026, at 10:00 AM. The venue is Room No. 205, 2nd floor, Centre for Cancer Epidemiology, Advanced Centre for Treatment, Research & Education in Cancer, Sector 22, Kharghar, Navi Mumbai - 410210.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should candidates bring for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring their Bio-data, Original certificates, Qualification Certificates, Experience Certificates, Birth Certificate, Photo, Pan Card, etc., along with a set of Xerox copies.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any age limit mentioned for the Scientific Assistant post?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify any minimum or maximum age limit for the Scientific Assistant position.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website of Tata Memorial Centre?
faq.answer: The official website of Tata Memorial Centre is www.actrec.gov.in. Candidates can visit this site for more information and updates.

faq.question: Q10. What is the nature of this job?
faq.answer: This is a project-based job, meaning the employment is for a specific project duration, as indicated by the job type.
